note: Partial's Pixels (tools/partials-pixels.js; runbook tools/partials-pixels-notes.md): the third play mode, every level one of PartialVoid's original pixel pictures, one art pixel = one board cell, her exact colours, nothing redrawn. paths: the art folder, the manifest, the suggestion folder, the bake scratch (gitignored) and the source record file (tools/pack.js packs it into levels/pixels.pk.json and levels/pixels-<k>.pk.json). limits: maxColours is Peter's cap for her pictures (the engine itself takes up to 12, tools/convert.js IDS: 1-9 and 11-13, iron 10 and gilt 14 never); the board's largest picture is tools/land-config.json box (40 x 44 cells inside the frame), read from there; maxPx the largest PNG side read. world: the mode's one world entry (ids <prefix><k>-<n>, era for the realm card, by on every record and the win line, credit on the map's foot and in LICENSES.md). map: the reused castle sheets (map/layout.json numbers, no new image bytes), first the one then the other, every other pair mirrored, perSheet levels on spots (road order), eggs at the painted side-quest spurs' tips in eggKinds' turn, all under tint (a CSS filter) so the mode reads apart from the Zen worlds. tags: picture n plays tags[(n - 1) % length] unless its manifest line names a tag. plan: each tag's deck features (? cards and linked pairs only: neither changes the picture; no mystery blocks, moats, gates, towers or locks ever). profile: merged over tools/land-config.json profile like a land's (bands, careful floor, pace, bake); seed: picture n's bake seed is seed + n. suggest: a colour merge is flagged as erasing a shape when edgeShare or more of the merged colour's edge touches the colour it would become; previews at previewPx px a cell. paceByCells (fix pass, critic S2): a picture's real-pace range and aim scale with its cells against ref (the Lighthouse's 40 x 40), never under floor of the profile's (a 32 x 32 picture plays about two thirds as long, so it is held to 96-300 s, aim 144 s; the upper bound never moves). retry: a picture whose bake falls back (misses a target) is baked again with each of these extra candidates in turn before the tool gives up and prints the next steps. suggest.warnDE: the run warns when a picture's closest two colours are nearer than this (CIEDE2000: a player may not tell them apart); suggest.shapeDE: a pair this near never counts as a drawn shape (twins, not an eye in a face), so the suggester may merge it.

world.name: Partial's Pixels

profile.note: Zen's casual profile (Picture Garden and the land worlds as they ship): generous random-tap bands, no lookahead ceiling, the careful floor 0.5 on every tag (v6 lane D5's rule for new Zen levels), the land pace range with the land aim, 8 candidates (10 on a Hard), 96 deal attempts. Her pictures are solid boards (every cell a block, no open ground inside the frame), so a squad reaches only the dug edge: the land default squads (20-50 at 1,400 cells) needed about 80 taps inside the 15 s longest-tap cap. Bigger squads (40-79 at 1,400 cells, so 50-99 on a 42 x 42 board), shallow burying (deep 0.05; Easy 0.04, Hard 0.08) and 400 deal attempts deal about one try in seven under every cap (measured on the Lighthouse).
